## Description

Briefly describe the change and the motivation behind it. Reference any related issues (e.g. `Fixes #123`).

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing behavior to change)

## Platforms Affected & Tested

- [ ] iPhone App
- [ ] Apple Watch App
- [ ] Live Activity / Dynamic Island
- [ ] Widgets / Complications

## Verification & Testing

Explain how you tested this change:
- [ ] Tested on iOS Simulator
- [ ] Tested on physical iPhone (model: _____)
- [ ] Tested on physical Apple Watch (model: _____)
- [ ] Swift unit tests pass (`swift test`)

## Privacy & Safety Checklist

- [ ] No personal or sensitive GPS coordinates (home, work), real health samples, or authentication secrets are included in tests, fixtures, or screenshots.
- [ ] Preserves local-first storage and explicit error reporting principles.
- [ ] Any UI changes include redacted before/after screenshots if applicable.
